# Features

- User auth with `admin` and `user` roles
- Admin approval flow for new accounts
- Per-user profiles
- Media ingest from TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook Reels
- File upload support
- Recipe metadata: prep time, cook time, servings, difficulty, category
- Recipe photos
- Recipe scaling and print view
- Cooking mode with step checklist
- Recipe favorites via local storage
- Recipe export/import as JSON
- Categories and category filtering
- Grocery list sharing via link, SMS, email, and text copy
- MySQL persistence
- Docker Compose deployment
